high_level_description: This image appears to be a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "gracieabrams," who has a verified account indicated by the checkmark next to their username. The post was made 19 hours prior to the screenshot being taken at 1:49 PM. The photo captures a person standing on the wooden stage of Red Rocks Amphitheatre, a famous outdoor concert venue located in Morrison, Colorado. The amphitheater is surrounded by distinctive red rock formations, which are a prominent feature of the landscape.
